title: Influence of Increased TaNbV on the Microstructure, Mechanical Properties, and Energy Release Characteristics of High-Entropy Alloy HfZrTi(TaNbV)<sub>x</sub>.

recollection.intervention: Guess: varying the composition by increasing the TaNbV content
recollection.structure: Guess: possibly a face-centered cubic (FCC) or body-centered cubic (BCC) solid solution, with potential precipitation of secondary phases
recollection.mechanism: Guess: the increased TaNbV content may alter the lattice distortion, electronic structure, and atomic bonding, influencing the mechanical properties and energy release characteristics
recollection.results: Guess: the increased TaNbV content may lead to changes in the alloy's strength, hardness, ductility, and energy absorption capacity, potentially resulting in improved or optimized properties for specific applications

score.note: The recollection only generically identifies increasing TaNbV, as already indicated by the title. It tentatively mentions BCC/secondary phases and lattice distortion but misses the specific HCP-to-BCC transition, omega-phase precipitation, strengthening and fragmentation/oxidation mechanisms, composition levels, and all quantitative mechanical and energy-release results.
